title: What can a short demo prove, and which outcome claims remain unsupported?
question: What can a short demo prove, and which outcome claims remain unsupported?
answer:
V3-17C: No. Prove both Codex and Claude user-scoped discovery paths deterministically and perform one cold-context resume; broader model-outcome trials are outside this interim release.
V3-17D: Show the manifest and lanes, run the bounded layout/spec/skill checks, and demonstrate that an existing installed skill was preserved; make no model-outcome claim.
